name: fissible/vouch
description: Laravel authentication with password, OTP, MFA, and recorded session assurance.

suggest.laravel/sanctum: Use it to issue and resolve Sanctum personal access tokens through Vouch's transaction-safe token issuer.
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Use it for roles and permissions; Vouch handles authentication and session assurance.

scripts-descriptions.mutate: Mutation testing over Fissible\Vouch\Kernel. Two runs: overall MSI >= 80 (detects untested classes), covered-code MSI >= 95 (primary quality gate).
scripts-descriptions.mutate:msi: Mutation score over every mutation, including ones on uncovered lines. Killed by tests/Kernel only: the Kernel is framework-free and its mutants must die to framework-free tests.
scripts-descriptions.mutate:covered: Mutation score over covered mutations only, ignoring lines the test suite never executes. Killed by tests/Kernel only, as mutate:msi.
scripts-descriptions.mutate:phase2: Mutation score over Phase 2 code (Fissible\Vouch excluding Kernel), all mutations. Scope and exclusions were fixed BEFORE the first run; narrowing them later to improve the score is forbidden.
scripts-descriptions.mutate:phase2:covered: Mutation score over Phase 2 code, covered mutations only. Never the sole gate -- the full pass runs alongside it.
